thread:
tess.l: heads up — post-webinar surge ~9k leads. a bunch are stuck in enrichment and RR assignment is timing out. seeing duplicate assign attempts to same two SDRs.

omar.b: can you share workflow id and sample error?

tess.l: workflow: webinar-q2-2026-handoff. sample log: POST /enrich status=504 latency=11s lead=L-2145.

hubspot-bot: [WARN] workflow webinar-q2-2026-handoff enrichment_timeouts=347 in last_30m; assign_retries_spike=true

paula.r: immediate mitigation idea: enable a lightweight fastpath profile for leads with missing enrichment after 8s — include email, name, campaign — and route to shared-sdr-pool with fallback owner. tradeoff: less enrichment data but faster CRM handoff.

omar.b: agree. also propose increasing claim_heartbeat for this workflow from 25s -> 75s to avoid duplicate claims while enrichment callbacks are inflight.

tess.l: sound plan. steps?

paula.r: plan:
- create fastpath flag for campaign=="webinar-q2-2026" threshold=8s
- set fallback_owner=shared-sdr-pool for fastpath leads
- bump claim_heartbeat to 75s for workflow webinar-q2-2026-handoff
- add alert pending_assignments>500 and owner_skew>3x

omar.b: applying 5% canary for fastpath and heartbeat change. will monitor pending_assignments and crm_upsert_success.

devops-bot: rollout started: webinar-q2-fastpath -> 5% (tag: wp-fastpath-canary)

tess.l: paste example webhook response that's slow:
```
POST /enrich HTTP/1.1
Host: enrich.redwood.ai
Body: {"leadId":"L-2145","email":"mike@example.com"}
HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
```

paula.r: longer-term: make allocator deterministic by hashing on lead.external_id + campaign, add a small distributed lease for 100ms during enrichment callback window, and surface per-campaign burst protections in console. also add DLQ to CRM for >4 retries.

omar.b: telemetry after canary (3m): pending_assignments 612 -> 98, assign_retries_rate 18% -> 4%. crm_upsert_latency_p95 improved 2.1s -> 1.4s.

tess.l: roll to 100% in 10m if stable. can we also add a public-facing note for sales that there may be slightly lower enrichment quality for webinar leads for the next hour?

paula.r: will ping @sales now and add a short doc in #marketing-runbooks about the fastpath tradeoffs.

hubspot-bot: metric update: pending_assignments=76, owner_skew_ratio=1.2

omar.b: :thumbsup:
